title: Verified results feed — 2026 NFL regular season

policy.settlement_source: Official NFL.com game/week pages only. A result is graded only after the official page prints FINAL.
policy.blank_rule: A value the official page does not publish stays blank and is flagged. Nothing is inferred.
policy.roi_rule: ROI is computed only from legs whose price we originated ourselves. n is published with every ROI.
policy.mirror_rule: nflverse/nfldata is a community mirror. It is used only for labelled cross-checks and is never a source of truth.
policy.origination_order: side (spread) first, then total, then moneyline

settlement_summary.roi_note: n = 13 graded game(s), 26 priced moneyline legs, 78 settled legs in total. The count is derived from the settlement rows rather than asserted in prose: when the results feed grew from 137 games to 150, the originated Week 10 slate went from 1 settleable fixture to 13, and a hand-written n would have been silently wrong. ROI is still arithmetically computable but statistically meaningless at this n; no skill claim is made from it. Both sides of each originated number are settled for bookkeeping — a strategy bets only the legs a pre-registered rule selects. Spread and total legs have no originated price yet (price authority open — see decisions Q-31), so no ROI is computed for them. Never inferred.

standings_arithmetic.description: Every club's W-L-T, points for and points against recomputed from the feed must equal the official NFL.com standings.
